hash_policy: SHA256 of file bytes after replacing CRLF with LF; no other normalization.
selection: Near-uniform annual case-article sampling; 2026 is a partial year.
provenance_notes: Grok summaries and livehrb_1k.json are a separate historical cohort, not substitutes.
pair_id is judgment-level; use item_id plus article_full for instance-level joins.
Keep all 1000 instances fixed; do not silently drop missing summary slots or use another summarizer to fill them.
This manifest verifies artifact identity and coverage, not factual fidelity or verdict leakage.
